issues.desc: 1998 transition. 법률 제5529호 took effect on 1998-02-28 (promulgated that afternoon). 공보처 was abolished and 문화체육부 became 문화관광부. 연합뉴스 (1998-02-28) lists 문화관광부 among the seven ministries whose heads were vacant, and 부칙 제3조② excludes 정무직 from the staff transfer, so 송태호 and 오인환 end on 1998-02-27 with no reorg continuation. MCST and ko.wikipedia instead run 송태호 to 1998-03-02. If the researcher treats 송태호 as de facto 문화관광부장관 for 02-28..03-02, add a reorg_continuation spell.

MCST 역대장관 dates usually set the outgoing minister's last day to the day before the successor's start. Where contemporaneous news shows a same-day exit (이임식 or 사표 수리 on the successor's appointment day), the roster uses a same-day handover: 신낙균 1999-05-24, 박지원 2000-09-20, 김한길 2001-09-19, 최광식 2013-03-11, 김종덕 2016-09-05, 도종환 2019-04-03. 김성재 2003-02-27, 유인촌 2011-01-27 and 황희 2022-05-13 are inferred from the successor.

For 정동채, MCST and ko.wikipedia give 2006-03-06 as his last day, but news shows him acting as minister through 2006-03-20 and leaving office on 2006-03-24 (전자신문 2006-03-25, 중앙일보 2006-03-24 via BigKinds). End set to 03-24. The formal date his resignation was accepted was not found, so 03-25..03-26 (a weekend) show as a vacancy before 김명곤 (03-27).

남궁진's resignation was accepted on the afternoon of 2002-07-08 to run in the 8·8 재보선 (서울신문, 인천일보 2002-07-09 via BigKinds). MCST and ko.wikipedia give 2002-07-10. Vacancy 2002-07-09..07-10. No 장관 직무대행 designation was found for these two days (차관 윤형규 was in office).

박지원 start 1999-05-24: the 5·24 개각 was announced that morning, the new ministers received their 임명장 that afternoon (연합뉴스 1999-05-24 17:12, 중앙일보 1999-05-25) and 신낙균 held her farewell that day. MCST and ko.wikipedia list 1999-05-23, which no contemporaneous report supports. No 관보 file exists for 1999. start_confidence raised to high by the verifier (the builder's reading of a 05-26 임명장 ceremony was not supported).
유진룡 end 2014-07-17: 연합뉴스, 뉴시스 and 대구일보 report that the President decided and notified the 면직 on 07-17. MCST and ko.wikipedia list 2014-07-16. The effective date on the 면직 order itself was not found.

황희 held his farewell on 2022-05-09, but 문재인 accepted only three ministers' resignations that day and not his, so he remained minister after 윤석열 took office. The date his resignation was accepted was not found. End set to 2022-05-13 (inferred from 박보균). MCST lists 05-12 and ko.wikipedia 05-10. The same question affects other 문재인 ministers who were not released on 05-09.

유인촌 (second spell) end 2025-07-30: 퇴임 and 이임식 on the morning of 07-30 per more than ten outlets (BigKinds). MCST lists 2025-07-28 and ko.wikipedia 2025-07-29. Successor 최휘영 is dated 2025-07-31 in 관보 제21057호, while ko.wikipedia gives 07-30 as his 취임일.

김종민 end 2008-02-28: 법률 제8852호 took effect on 2008-02-29 and 부칙 제2조② excludes 정무직, so the office 문화관광부 ended then.
